evals.prompt: Review the prose of Chapter 4. chapter=4, chapter_file='chapters/chapter-0004-the-trial-at-jianan-academy.md', project_root='agents/evals/files/test-project'; scripts_dir is this plugin's scripts directory.
evals.expected_output: Return a structured JSON issue list and a conclusion for each of five dimensions (dimension_results).
expectations: Output valid JSON containing an issues array and a summary string.
Include dimension_results covering setting, timeline, continuity, character, and logic individually.
Each dimension has a nonempty conclusion (pass when no issue exists).
Each issue category is one of setting/timeline/continuity/character/logic/pacing/other.
Every issue includes severity, category, location, and description.
Do not output overall_score; the reviewer does not assign scores.
Do not output an overall pass/fail verdict; the reviewer only lists issues.

evals.prompt: Review Chapter 4 for setting consistency. chapter=4, chapter_file='chapters/chapter-0004-the-trial-at-jianan-academy.md', project_root='agents/evals/files/test-project'; scripts_dir is this plugin's scripts directory.
evals.expected_output: Recognize that Xiao Yan uses suction control under Yao Lao's guidance consistently with the setting; do not report nonexistent setting conflicts.
expectations: Do not report Xiao Yan being a nine-star Dou Zhe as a setting conflict; it matches state.json.
Do not invent information absent from state.json to justify an issue.
